resources.string: Quotes link memories to existing chat text. Adding quotes does not add chats or characters.
Keep old memories and their quotes; skip %1$d new quotes for those memories.
Review the changes in this file
%1$d memories also have matching quotes. Review all changes in the file together. Updating a memory imports the matching quotes; keeping it keeps its existing quotes.

These quotes cannot be verified against your current chat. The original text may be missing or changed. Adjust import contents to skip these new quotes, or choose a backup containing the matching original chat. Unverified quotes will not replace existing content.
These memories are marked as verified, but their matching quotes are not selected. Adjust import contents to include the quotes, or keep the existing memories.
%1$d characters have existing names but are separate characters. Only choosing to save new characters creates independent copies. Existing characters and chats are kept.
Save these %1$d as new characters and keep existing characters
A chat is still generating a reply. Wait for it to finish or stop it, then refresh the import preview.
The selected content cannot be safely imported yet. Adjust import contents to skip the affected items or include their required content. You can view the specific reason below.
Nothing has been imported. Your existing content is unchanged.
Choose the file content or keep the current content. You can also adjust individual records. Next opens the import preview without changing your existing content.
Review what will be added, updated and kept. Only Start import writes these changes.
This choice applies to all %1$d changed existing records. You can adjust individual records. Files and app settings keep their separate choices.
Keep this memory and its quotes
Use the imported memory and matching quotes
Choose imported content and matching quotes for these %1$d memories? Other choices stay as they are. This only updates the preview. Existing content changes only after the final import confirmation.
Quotes and verification details follow the choice for this memory.
Related details follow this choice. Expand to review them.
Update existing content from the file
